scope: Real Chromium loads the full shipped HTML/CSS/JS with HTTP fixtures and a QA-only CJK font. No live package installation, Docker build or model inference.

checks.entry: full shipped app boot shows setup before loading workbench sessions/apps

checks.navigation: exactly three startup steps; discovery and LLM configuration share the first page

checks.discovery: selecting a discovered model fills configuration without adding or advancing a step

checks.api: full shipped api sends Idempotency-Key for real model-test and Kun configuration POSTs

checks.distribution: empty public catalog is explicit; pull is the default and no fake published image is offered
failed pull retry only refills the pull form, never starts a rebuild or Kun build repair
manual pull submits a durable runtime-image request and never silently builds or enables build repair
local build remains an explicit mode with preset/source controls and Kun repair
published preset selection sends exact catalog revision and selected registry source

checks.publication: image details block publication until server-side offline and smoke readiness passes
explicit confirmation sends a durable publish request, redacts logs, and does not confuse successful upload with anonymous visibility
catalog draft becomes available only after explicit anonymous-access check, without placeholder null text
public catalog editing preserves revision and saves only an explicit reviewed draft

checks.authentication: 401 login is visible above startup mask and successful login enters initialization
